# Fish Voice Server

Host Fish Audio's open-weights voice models (Drama 3 and S2 Pro) on a serverless GPU (Modal, or fal) behind one small HTTP API a game can call: POST /speak takes text and a voice and streams 16-bit PCM back, cloned zero-shot from a reference clip, with [tags] like [angry] or [laughing] for delivery, measured sampling settings, best-of-N takes, keep-warm and cost notes, and an optional S2 Pro fine-tune.
